answer: Tie rewards to outside demand: a key earns only from fees paid by distinct customers holding funded accounts, and each payer counts once per epoch toward any one vertex in the trade graph. A farm that pays itself just recycles its own money minus a 5% burn per trade, so every fake identity bleeds cash. When the tide of real demand goes out, sybil clusters show up like a bare reef: dense self-trade with no outside inflow, and they get zero payout.
